svg.title: Figure 10. Use Case Diagram
svg.desc: Health workers and midwives share the main functions, including experimental Record Review. Only midwives can delete child and vaccination records. Guardians do not sign in.

g.text: Staff functions; SMS is simulated; live recipients require approved setup
